title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S03 E03 — Pinkytown
Earp visits a shanty town that refuses to pay taxes to Dodge City, and Doc informs him that Dodge has no claim to the land; Earp manages to arrange the town's annexation in exchange for a new school, but Mayor Kelley alters the bargain.

title: Apache Country
description: A criminal gang provokes the local Apaches in order to divert the authorities' attention from their own activities.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S03 E04 — Shoot to Kill
Earp must keep an eye on two fugitives hiding out at Lucy King's home as he awaits a warrant, but when the public catches on, he has no choice but to risk a confrontation.

title: The Texas Rangers
description: The fastest gun (George Montgomery) in Texas is let out of prison to help the Rangers stop a gang of outlaws.

title: Through the Bible With Les Feldick
description: Les Feldick, an Oklahoma farmer and rancher with a special gift for teaching the Bible; his simple and nondenominational approach on the program "Through the Bible with Les Feldick" has reached millions around the world with the Gospel of Grace.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S03 E05 — Wells Fargo vs. Doc Holliday
Earp arrests Doc Holliday and Skunky Groggin for robbing a Wells Fargo stagecoach, but Doc denies involvement and concocts a plan with Earp to rob another stage to find the truth.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S03 E06 — Warpath
Lt. Clark alerts Earp about a renegade group of Pawnee who attacked him over a shipment of fake guns and becomes their captive when attempting negotiations; Earp must track down the guns' seller before the Pawnee execute Clark.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S03 E07 — Hung Jury
Reb Thomas stands accused of murdering Dan Bolton, although Earp suspects a frame-up, and despite Judge Tobin's efforts to hold a swift trial, one juror refuses to agree with the others.
